items.title: The two athletes in every horse race
summary_lines: 11 horses died at Churchill Downs in 2025, up from 6 the previous year; Santa Anita recorded its 30th fatality since end of December; jockey heart rates hit 170-190 bpm (~95% max).
Jockey ReyLu Gutiérrez has started in 6,000+ races; Michaela Keener is a jockey health researcher at University of Kentucky.
Garmin and StrideSafe wearable sensors identify a horse's 'running fingerprint', healthy gait baseline, and flag deviations to catch microfractures before they become catastrophic.
Catastrophic fractures often start as tiny microfractures building up over time; daily wearable use could prevent significant injury and improve return-to-performance prognosis.
items.why: Concrete fatality numbers and biometric specifics make the case for wearable tech in horse racing tangible.

items.title: Block Universe Theory: Is Time Just a Loaf of Bread?
summary_lines: Spacetime as a loaf of bread: every slice is a separate moment and a full snapshot of the entire universe at one instant.

Traces to Einstein 1905 (no universal now) and philosopher Hilary Putnam 1967 (past and future as real as the present moment).

items.title: 6 Mindsets That Make People Respect You During Conflict

Coach distinguishes explanation from excuse: "they've had hard lives" followed by "they're my lads, my responsibility", owns the outcome.
Quote: "I can return your goods, but I can't return the inconvenience, the time, the headache", acknowledges irreparable harm.
items.why: The apology framework applies directly to workplace and relationship conflicts where ego wants to deflect.

items.title: Check Instead of Track
summary_lines: Tracking = continuous monitoring of every face, expression, pause, tone shift; Checking = brief glance at natural pauses (after a point, topic change, direct response) then back to conversation.
Checking gives the signals that actually matter and lets attention stay on the conversation instead of running a second-by-second emotional readout.
items.why: A practical reframe for meeting fatigue and social anxiety; costs nothing to apply.

items.title: Why the One Annoyed Face Is the One That Rides Home With You
